summary: get_budget_snapshot emits would_pause_next_cycle/would_throttle_next_cycle aliases for feed/PM/ops; get_cost_dashboard accepts budget_base_dir (PM forwards it); scheduled_ops_status hydrates spend under base_dir/budget.
migration_impact: No downstream config. Consumers may read would_pause_next_cycle from snapshots; isolated PM/dashboard/ops status no longer clobber operator spend.
agent_notes: Prefer would_pause_next_cycle (alias of would_pause) when wiring feed/PM. Pass budget_base_dir into get_cost_dashboard when ProjectManager.budget_base_dir is set.
